"If your profile is shortlisted after the initial screening process, a member of the HR team will contact you to schedule the interview."





Key Requirements

Hands-on experience in Generative AI projects.
Strong expertise in Natural Language Processing (NLP).
Proficiency in Python, SQL, and Microsoft Azure.
Understanding of RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), LLMs, Neural Networks, and other AI/ML concepts.
Experience in designing and implementing AI/ML models.
Hands-on experience with AI/ML frameworks and technologies such as:
TensorFlow
PyTorch
LangChain
Large Language Models (LLMs)
RAG Architecture

Desired Skills

Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
Ability to work in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.
Strong project management and organizational skills.
Ability to explain complex technical concepts to business and non-technical stakeholders.
